POLYGON_ANTIPODAL_EDGE: The polygon contains an edge that spans exactly 180°. Please split it into smaller segments.
POLYGON_AREA_EXCEEDED: The massif polygon area exceeds the maximum allowed size of 35,000 km².
POLYGON_CROSSES_EQUATOR: The polygon contains a ring that crosses the equator. Please split it into separate northern and southern polygons.
POLYGON_DISCONNECTED: The polygon interior is split into disconnected parts. Please draw it as separate polygons.
POLYGON_DUPLICATE_RINGS: The polygon contains duplicate rings. Please remove the repeated boundary.
POLYGON_HOLE_OUTSIDE: A hole is located outside the outer boundary. Please ensure all holes are within the polygon.
POLYGON_INVALID: The polygon could not be processed. Please simplify or redraw it.
POLYGON_INVALID_WINDING: The polygon rings have an invalid winding order. Exterior rings must be counter-clockwise and holes must be clockwise.
POLYGON_NESTED_HOLES: The polygon contains holes within holes. Please flatten the hole structure.
POLYGON_SELF_INTERSECTION: The polygon edges cross each other. Please redraw without self-intersections.
POLYGON_TOO_FEW_POINTS: The polygon does not have enough points. A valid polygon needs at least 4 coordinates.
